def resolve_builder_binding(mapping, logical_member, expected_data):
    """Bind an explicitly named logical builder to its unique canonical descriptor."""
    need(digest(expected_data) == BUILDER_SHA, 'Original builder bytes differ')
    matches = [row for row in mapping['copy_map'] if row['restore_path'] == logical_member]
    need(len(matches) == 1, 'Original builder logical member missing or ambiguous')
    row = matches[0]
    need(row['sha256'] == BUILDER_SHA and type(row['bytes']) is int
         and row['bytes'] == len(expected_data) and row['mode'] == 'byte_exact',
         'Original builder logical descriptor differs')
    canonical = [item for item in mapping['files']
                 if item['canonical_public_path'] == row['canonical_public_path']]
    need(len(canonical) == 1 and canonical[0]['sha256'] == BUILDER_SHA
         and type(canonical[0]['bytes']) is int and canonical[0]['bytes'] == len(expected_data),
         'Original builder canonical descriptor missing, ambiguous, or different')
    return row
